Notes to the financial statements
1. Basis of preparation

The consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with UK-adopted international accounting standards. They are presented in pounds sterling, and all values are rounded to the nearest thousand except where otherwise indicated. The directors have prepared the financial statements on a going concern basis.
2. Dividends
During the year the Company paid dividends of £5.1 million, equivalent to 7.25 pence per share.
